tokens.styling: flexbox props on <Box> (Yoga layout) + inline color/dimColor on <Text>; a restrained accent
tokens.layout: flex containers with borderStyle/padding; size scroll viewports via measureElement

components.name: Static
components.when_to_use: append-only output (logs/chat) that must never re-render

rules: Default widgets to @inkjs/ui — never the stale standalone ink-* packages (ink-progress-bar 2019, ink-multi-select 2020, ink-table 2023 predate ink@6/7).
Put append-only output in <Static> and memoize hot subtrees — Ink has a repaint ceiling (~30 FPS) and laggs on high-frequency streaming/large live tables.
Guard useInput with a raw-mode TTY check (isRawModeSupported); never console.log into the managed region — use <Static> or useStdout().write.
If you hit Ink's ceiling (high perf, large scroll buffers, code/diff views, 3D, SSH), OpenTUI is the successor; otherwise stay on Ink for Node-first stability.
